finding.expected: Make the reported consistency diagnostic for a contradictory pair semantically invariant to input permutation, including cases with multiple equally valid positive paths, without changing pairwise resolution semantics, inventing transitive relationships, or introducing clustering. Add focused regression coverage with at least two competing positive paths to the same direct DIFFERENT_PRODUCT pair and prove equivalent diagnostics across input permutations.
finding.issue: Conflict diagnostics are not fully permutation-invariant when the same contradictory pair is connected by more than one equally short positive product-family path. The BFS path choice follows adjacency insertion order, and adjacency insertion order follows the caller's observation order, so permuting the same semantic observation set can change positive_path and affected_identities even though all pairwise decisions are unchanged.
